config.theme: Robot Riot — combat-robotics event postcard; classic fight-night ring composition with battling Cutebots and modern kids
config.scene_description: A bright, warmly lit sporting-hall interior on tournament night — a modern kids' combat-robotics event staged like an old-school fight night: a low circular spindle-railed pit on the plank floor at center, slightly below the viewer, with FOUR stylized blue Cutebot robots battling inside it — two crashing head-on, one knocked spinning into the air, a wheel and LEGO beams popping off. Four excited modern kids in hoodies, t-shirts, and sneakers lean on the pit rail driving the robots with handheld joystick controllers; behind them only about ten distinct, individually posed spectators plus a few flat silhouettes on the balcony above. Headline "ROBOT RIOT" across the top.

SCENE — a packed 19th-century sporting-hall interior on fight night, joyfully reimagined as a kids' combat-robotics event. On the plank floor at center sits a low circular pit fenced by thin vertical iron spindles with a wooden top rail. Four thrilled kids, ages 10–14, a mix of boys and girls, lean on the pit rail at four points around the ring — the drivers — each gripping a handheld joystick controller, faces lit warm from the pit: shouting, laughing, one punching the air. Around them a dense crowd of more kids and a few adult mentors presses in on wooden benches, cheering; one kid in the front row points dramatically at the airborne robot. Across the back, a balcony gallery with curtained boxes overflows with spectators leaning over the rail. Mood: electric, joyful, slightly rowdy — a Victorian prizefight's energy poured into a school robot derby.

The kids' controllers match the collage's joystick controller: a micro:bit board mounted on a curved blue-and-red grip frame with a white joystick knob and small round black buttons — never a video-game gamepad. Do NOT copy the collage's grid layout, white studio background, or any of its labels.
